name: Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Childhood Associated with a Systemic Disease
aliases: Systemic Disease-Associated Pediatric Interstitial Lung Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Pediatric Interstitial Lung Disease Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of chronic respiratory symptoms such as persistent tachypnea, cough, and hypoxemia
High-resolution CT scan showing interstitial lung abnormalities consistent with ILD
Evidence of underlying systemic disease known to cause secondary ILD (e.g., connective tissue disease, immunodeficiency)
Histopathological confirmation of interstitial lung disease if clinically indicated
Restrictive ventilatory defect and impaired gas exchange on pulmonary function testing

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: chronic respiratory symptoms, characteristic radiologic findings, and confirmed systemic disease association
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is reserved for atypical cases or when diagnosis remains uncertain after non-invasive testing.

common.symptomName: Arthralgia or arthritis related to systemic disease

rare.symptomName: Severe respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) associated with systemic disease
Autoantibodies relevant to underlying systemic disease (e.g., ANA, RF, anti-Scl-70)
Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: High-resolution CT showing ground-glass opacities, reticular changes, and interstitial thickening
Echocardiography to assess for pulmonary hypertension
genetic: No specific genetic markers; genetic testing may be indicated if associated with inherited systemic diseases
other: Pulmonary function tests demonstrating restrictive pattern and reduced diffusing capacity
Lung biopsy showing interstitial inflammation and fibrosis when performed

distinguishingFeatures: Associated situs inversus in some cases

redFlags: Severe hypoxemia refractory to oxygen therapy
references: Fan LL, Deterding RR, et al. Pediatric Interstitial Lung Disease: Diagnosis and Management. Pediatr Pulmonol. 2020.
Orphanet: Secondary interstitial lung disease specific to childhood associated with a systemic disease. ORPHA:264699.
American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society International Multidisciplinary Consensus Classification of the Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2002.
